{{Quote|Psst! Hey you! Yeah you! C'mere. You look as if you'd be suitable to join Jabba's forces. But keep your voice down. The Empire rules this place and doesn't take kindly to members of the Hutt family.|Errik Darksider, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ED" />}}
'''Errik Darksider''' was a member of [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well, you'd have to talk to Jabba about that. I can't just sign you up. But I can tell you the location of our hideout. Maybe you can scope it out and see if you like it. It's gonna cost you, though. In fact, I have a couple of places you might be interested in.|Errik Darksider, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ED" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Errik Darksider resided in the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While here, he encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who he surmised would make a suitable candidate for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] forces. Errik told the spacer that he knew the whereabouts of certain locations on Tatooine, including the [[Hutt Hideout]] outside of Mos Eisley. For several [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Errik agreed to betray Jabba and tell the spacer of Hutt Hideout's location. He also agreed to give the whereabouts of two other locations for additional credits, including a destroyed [[Rebel Military Base (Tatooine)|Rebel Military Base]] and a [[Tusken Bunker|bunker]] overrun by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].<ref name="SWG:ED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Errik Darksider was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Errik Darksider was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref>

Players who talk to him could receive the waypoints to three locations on Tatooine, including the [[Hutt Hideout]], a [[Tusken Bunker]], and a destroyed [[Rebel Military Base (Tatooine)|Rebel Military Base]]. For Errik to give the player the waypoints, the player must agree to pay varying amounts of credits for each location.<ref name="SWG:ED" />
